_comment: Describes this standalone build for ../lesson-app-tools/. UNLIKE grades 1 to 4, this one is NOT wired to the platform shell: the unit is a single self-contained page with no module imports, no progress reporting, no Wehel and no hand-raise. deploy.mjs uploads the four shared modules unconditionally, so they will land in the remote directory and nothing will load them. The hub IS the unit, so it ships twice: as index.html for a stable route and under its own name.
subject: mathematics
